verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no CLI commands that add, remove, or upgrade dependencies by rewriting a project manifest and lockfile. The only related command is `nix-env --upgrade`, which changes an imperative user profile, not a declarative manifest or lockfile, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The declarative path documented is writing the specification by hand (e.g. configuration.nix), and nothing in the pack covers lockfile-editing commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add, remove, and upgrade dependencies through CLI commands that safely rewrite the manifest and lockfile, so an agent never hand-edits them
